project_text: In the Broad Street Station Redevelopment, James Street Commons Zone, the applicant proposes to construct a four (4) story multi-family Residential building. The applicant is seeking a 3-year extension. Extension Approval is required.

In the West Ward Model Neighborhood Initiative / C-2 Zone, the applicant proposes construction of a new three story mixed-use building, commercial/office space on the ground floor and three (3) residential units above. The applicant is seeking a 1-year extension. Extension Approval is required.

In the C-1 Zone, the applicant proposes to demolish the existing structure and construct a 4-story multi-family residential building. This application was approved on August 15, 2022. The application received a one-year extension on March 11, 2024 and August 18th, 2025. The applicant is seeking a two-year extension.

In the C-2 Zone, the applicant is proposing to develop a new 4-story mixed use building with 24 residential units, two retail spaces and 23 parking spaces. Applicant is seeking 11 “c” variances for Excessive Front Yard Setback (x2), Excessive Side Yard Setback (x2), Insufficient Ground Level Street Facing Façade Transparency – Leslie Street, Insufficient Non-Street Facing Façade Transparency, Insufficient Ground Floor Height, Insufficient Micromobility Spaces, Insufficient Covered Parking Illumination, Insufficient/Excessive Off-Street/Surface Parking Illumination, Excessive Building Entrance Illumination. Site Plan Approval is required.
